mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, thereby increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1.0% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a severe economic contraction (as indicated by industrial production falling below 100 for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to heightened recession risks and reduced corporate investment, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 50,000 jobs per month signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 750,000 units per month, it indicates a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a falling federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a monetary policy response to a deepening recession, which typically leads to negative equity returns as the market prices in prolonged economic weakness over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of negative GDP growth (as measured by GDPC1), the S&P 500 tends to decline due to reduced corporate earnings and increased risk aversion, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
